continuation-S2-F3.mechanism: F3 late RUNNING over terminal publication
continuation-S2-F3.note: C7 seed uses SJ rc1 before bootstrap (ordinary early failure), records the exception, publishes EXECUTION_EXCEPTION, then JR:711 writes RUNNING. It does not rely on a premature clean SJ/CJ return.

continuation-S2-F5.mechanism: F5 START KeyError and authoritative-outcome loss
continuation-S2-F5.note: C7 short seed uses a STARTING CJ generic rc1 mapped104, both successful launch replies, active fail_run removing pending, then JR:360 KeyError and :720 FAILED_TO_RUN. It does not rely on the 60-second sync timeout or an unexplained bare typed process code.
